description: Calculate Johnson-Nyquist thermal noise voltage, current and available power kTB, Schottky shot noise, noise figure and noise temperature (290 K reference), input noise floor and SNR in dB, and the ideal ADC quantization SNR (6.02 N + 1.76 dB) with ENOB from a measured SINAD. Classical white-noise formulas with CODATA 2018 constants; every answer cites Johnson, Nyquist, Schottky, Friis and Kester.

bandwidth_hz.description: Noise bandwidth in hertz, greater than 0.

current_a.description: DC current for shot noise in ampere, 0 or more; default 0.

noise_figure_db.description: Noise figure in dB, 0 to 200; default 0.

noise_temperature_k.description: Optional noise temperature in kelvin; overrides the noise figure.

signal_dbm.description: Signal power at the input in dBm; default -100.

sinad_db.description: Measured ADC SINAD in dB, at least 1.76; default 74.

name: noise_calculator
title: Thermal and shot noise
